summary: Fixed O-009 only. blockedComment gains ParentUnpublished, set in adminBlocked when `bc.Reply && !c.Published`. admin_blocked.html prints ', in reply to a comment (the report has no reader page)' for it, and keeps ', in reply to a hidden comment' only for a published report whose parent Find did not locate. The code review's test is now at internal/server/blocked_unpublished_label_test.go and passes. The full suite and both E-006 finish-line bodies (scratch copy, real binary) still pass.

files.why: blockedComment.ParentUnpublished set when the reply is on a report with no reader page; doc comments on the type and on adminBlocked say which case 'hidden' covers
separate wording for a reply on an unpublished report; 'hidden' kept only for a published report's undrawn parent
the code review's test, TestBlockedPageUnpublishedReplyIsNotToAHiddenComment, as given (CRLF line endings only)

obligations.how: adminBlocked sets blockedComment.ParentUnpublished for a reply on a draft or unpublished report. The template prints ', in reply to a comment (the report has no reader page)' for it, and ', in reply to a hidden comment' only when the report is published and Find located no parent (TestBlockedPage still checks that case). `go test -count=1 -run ^TestBlockedPageUnpublishedReplyIsNotToAHiddenComment$ ./internal/server` passes. With the flag forced to false the test fails.

tests.note: The engine's own closing run. With the fix removed (ParentUnpublished forced to false) it fails.
TestBlockedPage still asserts the unpublished 'gone' entry links to /admin/reports/gone with no #comment- anchor, and the hidden-parent entry still says 'in reply to a hidden comment'.
Every package ok; go vet ./internal/server clean; admin.go and the new test are gofmt-clean on LF-normalised content.

tests.command: python -I tests\acceptance\test_e006_2_blocking_and_unblocking.py and test_e006_1_removal_and_placeholders.py (bodies read from the ledger with a mode=ro SELECT, run in a scratch copy of this tree)
tests.note: Both exit 0 against the real built binary. The scratch folder was removed afterwards.
